normalization: lowercase Hebrew/Latin/digits, punctuation removed, whitespace collapsed; diacritics removed
near_text_method: all session pairs with >=20 source whitespace words; word unigram/bigram TF-IDF sublinear_tf; cosine>=0.92; exclude normalized exact duplicates
limitations: Existing real canonical fingerprints hash decoded PCM; synthetic fingerprints hash WAV bytes, not cross-class comparable
Source demographic descriptors are not synthetic perceived age/sex
Listening manifests cover identities, not estimated population prevalence
